model_annotation: This bar chart compares the "effect" values across nine linguistic families—IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic—for six different language models: mBERT-L₂ (light gray), XLM-L₂ (blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (red). The horizontal axis lists the linguistic families in a left-to-right order, while the vertical axis represents the "effect" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each linguistic family has a group of six bars corresponding to the models, with error bars indicating variability or confidence intervals. The tallest bars are observed in the IE-Indic family, where mBERT-R₂ (light green) reaches approximately 20, XLM-R₂ (dark green) reaches about 18, and mBERT-B₂ (light pink) and XLM-B₂ (red) are near 23 and 21, respectively. In contrast, the Uralic family shows very low effect values, with all bars close to 0. The Semitic family also shows relatively high values, particularly for XLM-L₂ (blue) and mBERT-B₂ (light pink), with the latter reaching approximately 16 and having a large error bar. The Isolate family shows minimal effects across all models. Bars are sorted within each group by model type as defined in the legend, and no specific visual emphasis (e.g., bolding or shading) is applied beyond the color coding.
